serverUrlDesc: pawn-server base URL (reachable from the SiYuan kernel)
mentionTokenDesc: Prefix that activates wrap + Send (must match server)
autoWrapCalloutDesc: Convert a leading @pawn paragraph into a TIP callout when sending
sendBusy: Pawn is already working on this callout
notConfigured: Configure Pawn server URL in plugin settings
noCallout: No @pawn callout found for this block
